description: Combine two disjoint-region wins that both fork eef2bc18: fb334186d (barrier-reduction slimBar+fuseS2 on the mega_eigh_med_split_k reduced-block kernel, helping shapes 2/3/8/11/12) and cf3d49aa8 (conditioning-gated single-pass CholeskyQR on the low-rank complement compl_pass2, helping shapes 3/8/10/12, measured -0.74%). The barrier changes are in the CUDA megakernel source; the single-pass-CQR is in _lr_cholesky_qr2 torch routing — disjoint code regions, so they should stack. Integrate both, re-benchmark, keep the residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback + orthogonality-edge calibration; verify 39/39 and no shape regresses.

Two combine runs avg ~27093us. Per-shape stable: s2 6082 s3 73286 s8 80309 s10 90589 s11 71851 s12 29017. DECOMPOSITION vs parents: combine ~27093 vs PARENT A 27226.872 = -0.6pct (holds A's barrier win); vs PARENT B 27042.79 (2-run avg ~27037) = +0.2pct (WITHIN NOISE -- combine does NOT clearly beat B). The two wins do not fully stack to ~26.9k: on overlap shapes 3/8/12 the geomean sits on B's floor. Per-shape overlap: s3 73248-73286 (~= B 73189, < A 74389); s8 79911-80309 (~= B 80075, < A 80766); s12 28855-29017 (< B 29062 AND < A 29944 -- s12 DOES stack, both contribute). s11 71738-71851 (~= A 71801, A-only shape) and s10 90488-90589 (~= B 90361, B-only shape) both held. Net: A's win survives the combine, B's win survives, but on the shared large n=512/1024 shapes the two are near-additive at the noise floor rather than multiplicatively stacking.

t3 (FINAL, profiled): combined A+B with CQR gate margin=2.0 (kd^2<160). Geomean 27062.854 (margin=1.0 combine was 27067/27120). Profile shape8 (rankdef, tail-heavy overlap) CONFIRMS both wins active + fallback=0: mega_eigh_med_split_k #1 kernel 41.5pct (PARENT A barrier-reduced megakernel dominates), batch_trsm_left 24 instances (single-pass gate skipping compl pass-2, was 26 gate-off), and ZERO cuSOLVER/syevd/sytrd kernels in the timed range (no fallback triggered even at aggressive margin=2.0). DECOMPOSITION (combine avg vs each parent, per-shape): s2 6083 (~=A 6068, A-only, held); s3 73267 (~=B 73189, <A 74389 -- B dominates, A's barrier delta absorbed); s8 80110 (~=B 80075, <A 80766 -- B dominates); s10 90538 (~=B 90361, B-only, held); s11 71795 (~=A 71801, A-only, held); s12 28936 (<B 29062 AND <A 29944 -- wins STACK here). VERDICT: both wins independent + survive combine, NO shape regresses vs the better parent (B ~27042). Combine geomean ~27080 does NOT beat B ~27037 because A's barrier win is small on overlap shapes 3/8 (absorbed under B's larger CQR win) and the geomean is pulled by the n=512/1024 shapes B already captured; A contributes mainly via shapes 11/12. margin knob has no residual headroom (B already skipped 99.7pct of pass-2 at margin=1.0).

COMBINE A+B DONE (3 trials, all committed, best commit 8bad5522f @ 27067us / margin-2.0 variant 0ef8e5a89 @ 27063us). Integrated via CLEAN git-merge (no conflicts): cf3d49aa8 single-pass-CQR (PARENT B) merged into fb334186d slimBar+fuseS2 barrier-reduction (PARENT A); both fork eef2bc18, disjoint regions (A=mega_eigh_med_split_k CUDA + _SIGN_DC_SLIMBAR/FUSES2; B=_lr_cholesky_qr2 kd-gate). BOTH WINS PRESENT + ACTIVE (verified by grep AND by nsys on shapes 8+12: mega_eigh_med_split_k is #1 kernel 41.5pct/24.2pct AND batch_trsm_left instance-count drops 26->24 / 58->48 from the single-pass gate). 39/39 valid, 'stream' absent, -O3, FP64 residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback intact and NOT triggered (0 syevd kernels in profiled range even at aggressive margin=2.0). PER-SHAPE DECOMPOSITION (combine vs A vs B): the wins are INDEPENDENT and both survive, NO shape regresses vs the better parent. Shape 12 STACKS cleanly (combine 28936 < B 29062 < A 29944 < base 30271 -- both deltas apply). Shapes 3/8 do NOT visibly stack: A's barrier delta there is tiny (s3 -0.1pct, s8 -0.3pct A-alone) and is ABSORBED under B's larger CQR delta (s3 -1.7pct, s8 -1.1pct B-alone), so combine sits on B's floor (s3 73267~=B 73189; s8 80110~=B 80075). A-only shapes 2/11 held (6083~=6068, 71795~=71801); B-only shape 10 held (90538~=90361). NET: A contributes to the combine mainly through shapes 11/12; B through 3/8/10/12; they overlap on 3/8/12 where B is the dominant lever on the n=512/1024 total time -- so the combine holds the union of both wins but the geomean is pinned at B's floor rather than moving to ~26.9k. OPEN DIRECTIONS (not pursued, for the manager): (1) A's barrier win is currently near-invisible on the geomean because shapes 3/8 are dominated by the complement CQR + dense-GEMM path, NOT the reduced-block megakernel -- a brief that makes A's barrier lever bite on a shape where mega_eigh_med_split_k is a LARGER time fraction (e.g. shape 11 nearrank, where it's already helping, or a further barrier cut baseline 4->3/col) would let A's contribution show in the geomean. (2) the CQR gate margin has no headroom (1.0->2.0 flat; B already skips 99.7pct of pass-2) but compl_pass1 (currently 2-pass) or the DOMINANT-block CQR (dom_power, currently ungated) are un-probed single-pass candidates on this combined base. (3) with both wins locked, the geomean floor on shapes 3/6/7/8 (all n=512 batch-640, ~73-106ms) is set by the dense/mixed cuSOLVER + complement path -- an algorithmic departure there (batched dense solve, or the low-rank peel replacing more of the dense residual) is the lever the +0.6pct combine cannot reach, matching the gap-to-#1 pattern.
